data.title: LANA On The Park
data.about:
Lana on the Park is a modern and stylish 17-storey apartment complex by developer Nshama, located opposite a picturesque park in the amazing Town Square neighborhood. 

The design of the building is characterized by flowing lines, elevated windows and dynamic elements, so that the complex fits perfectly into the surrounding landscape. The project features 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments as well as spacious 3 bedroom duplexes.

This modern complex stands out for its unparalleled proximity to the main park, giving residents direct access to lush green spaces and recreational amenities including a swimming pool, gym, sports and children's playgrounds, walking and jogging paths, barbecue and recreational areas, and pet walking areas. Lana on the Park seamlessly blends the convenience of urban living with natural beauty, promising a lifestyle that combines daily activities with the tranquility of a park-like setting.
